principle: Show the result before explaining the feature.

hook.selectionReason: Open on the guest’s selected statement, allow a genuine reaction, then return to the question that gives it context.
hook.audience: Podcasters introducing the person behind a familiar public identity
hook.promise: Open on the guest’s selected statement, allow a genuine reaction, then return to the question that gives it context.

variations.label: Question first
variations.description: Lead with the host, then hear the statement.

hook.selectionReason: Keep the provocative question intact and cut to the selected answer, with the speaker’s own words carrying the reveal.
hook.audience: Interviewers cutting an identity or origin-story introduction
hook.promise: Keep the provocative question intact and cut to the selected answer, with the speaker’s own words carrying the reveal.

variations.label: Answer first
variations.description: Flash forward to the selected answer before the complete question.

hook.selectionReason: Flash forward into a decisive action beat, reveal the wider conflict, accelerate the exchanges and leave a meaningful open question.
hook.audience: Filmmakers and sport storytellers building a teaser
hook.promise: Flash forward into a decisive action beat, reveal the wider conflict, accelerate the exchanges and leave a meaningful open question.

variations.label: Slow-burn opening
variations.description: Establish the space before the same accelerating conflict.

hook.selectionReason: Tease the outcome, return to the struggle and follow a small concrete movement toward hope; optional narration remains a separate editable take.
hook.audience: Creators telling an honest resilience or transformation story
hook.promise: Tease the outcome, return to the struggle and follow a small concrete movement toward hope; optional narration remains a separate editable take.

variations.label: Struggle first
variations.description: Start with the lived problem before revealing the hopeful image.

templates.label: Motion type · One more, then another

hook.selectionReason: Cut real movement to five authored word accents, build pressure, then leave the result moving; each word and sound accent remains an ordinary editable layer.
hook.audience: Creators using a short statement as the rhythm of a footage edit
hook.promise: Cut real movement to five authored word accents, build pressure, then leave the result moving; each word and sound accent remains an ordinary editable layer.

variations.label: Reverse angle
variations.description: Swap the opening movement and let the same five-word rhythm drive the cuts.

templates.label: Creator · Make the cut mean something

hook.selectionReason: Show a held unstructured shot, then assemble preparation, context and a finished result; the actual cut sequence demonstrates the editing decision.
hook.audience: Food and editing creators teaching sequence and pacing
hook.promise: Show a held unstructured shot, then assemble preparation, context and a finished result; the actual cut sequence demonstrates the editing decision.

variations.label: Result first
variations.description: Lead with the finished result, then demonstrate how the sequence earns it.
